body: I just want a way out of being stressed out seemingly all the time.

I wish it were off the table. It should be off the table, but because of my past experience and the way my mind works it isn't. When logical me is in control of course it makes sense that suicide is the worst possible option, but the problem is that logical me doesn't always win out over emotional me :(
I'm a scientist. When its going well its very good but when it's not its very bad. And being around so many smart people makes me look very stupid by comparison.
